title: Queen's chamber sarcophagus as healing device

tellings.quote: Yeah. That that uh sarcophagus they called it in in the queen's chamber. It's probably a healing device.

plain: A man named Steve Coburn, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt. He says the stone box in the room called the Queen's chamber, the thing people call a sarcophagus, or stone coffin, was "probably a healing device." If he is right, the pyramid was built for more than burial.
